def transform(grid):
    hflip = [row[::-1] for row in grid]
    vflip = grid[::-1]
    r180 = [row[::-1] for row in vflip]
    blocks = [
        [r180, vflip, r180],
        [hflip, grid, hflip],
        [r180, vflip, r180],
    ]
    out = []
    for block_row in blocks:
        for inner_row in range(3):
            out.append([value for block in block_row for value in block[inner_row]])
    return out
